_comment: Components in the image that SBOM scanners cannot find, because no package manager installed them. scripts/sbom_report.py adds them (and Jigsaurium itself) to the scanned SBOM. Keep in line with THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; tests/test_sbom_report.py checks the versions against package.json and the Dockerfile.
